summary.whatChanges: Updates documented default values only: `benchmark.exclude` is now shown as `['**/node_modules/**', '**/.git/**']` instead of the old list (and `[]` in JSDoc), and `watch` is documented as also defaulting to `false` when an AI coding agent is detected. No runtime code is changed.
risks: Docs/JSDoc claim defaults (agent-detection for watch, new benchmark exclude globs) that are not implemented in any code visible in this diff, so they could be inaccurate if the corresponding logic doesn't exist
The JSDoc glob is written with an escaped separator (`**\/node_modules/**`) to avoid closing the comment block, which may render oddly in editor tooltips
